desc:
Speedster Roleplay is a free roam sandbox game full of all of your favorite characters such as The Flash, Hulk and many more.

🎁Join the group to unlock a free speed boost!
✨Premium players also get a free speed boost!

🔥Characters Included:
-Speedsters
-Superhumans
-Marvel Characters
>>AND MANY MORE<<

Leave any ideas and suggestions in the group!
All controls are in-game.

💕Credit to @shen_kiji for a few thumbnails.
💕Credit to Symbiotic's Threads for some of the clothes.
